import math

base_length = 80.0

rib = Pos(rail_width/2 + rib_thickness/2, 0, 0) * Box(rib_thickness, rib_height, rail_length)

inner = Box(rail_width - 2*wall_thickness, rail_height - 2*wall_thickness, rail_length - 2*wall_thickness)
result = result - inner

    z = (i - (hole_count - 1) / 2) * hole_spacing
    hole = Pos(0, 0, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, rail_height + 10)

from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 55.0
inner_diameter = 20.0
length = 80.0
relief1_diameter = 30.0
relief1_length = 12.0
relief1_position = 25.0
relief2_diameter = 35.0
relief2_length = 12.0
relief2_position = 50.0
chamfer_size = 1.5
mount_hole_diameter = 5.0
mount_hole_offset = 22.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
relief1_radius = relief1_diameter / 2.0
relief2_radius = relief2_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((outer_radius, 0), (outer_radius, length))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (inner_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (inner_radius, relief2_position + relief2_length))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (relief2_radius, relief2_position + relief2_length))
            l5 = Line(l4@1, (relief2_radius, relief2_position))
            l6 = Line(l5@1, (inner_radius, relief2_position))
            l7 = Line(l6@1, (inner_radius, relief1_position + relief1_length))
            l8 = Line(l7@1, (relief1_radius, relief1_position + relief1_length))
            l9 = Line(l8@1, (relief1_radius, relief1_position))
            l10 = Line(l9@1, (inner_radius, relief1_position))
            l11 = Line(l10@1, (inner_radius, 0))
            l12 = Line(l11@1, (outer_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges(), chamfer_size)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(mount_hole_offset, 0, length/2) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter/2, length + 10)

part = solid_body
part.name = "revolved_shaft_with_reliefs"
export_step(part, "output.step")
